Project rules (always apply):
- Never run a destructive git command (reset --hard, clean -f, push --force, branch -D, checkout .). Prefer reversible operations; if a destructive one is truly needed, stop and confirm first.

This repo has no .gitignore. Add one covering the usual Python build and cache artifacts.

events.text:
Created `.gitignore` with comprehensive Python build and cache artifact patterns, including:
- `__pycache__/` and compiled Python files
- Virtual environment directories (`venv/`, `env/`, `.venv/`)
- Distribution and build artifacts
- Test coverage and pytest cache
- IDE settings (`.vscode/`, `.idea/`)
- Common development files (`.env`, `.DS_Store`, editor swap files)
